name: bybit_level_reaction_v1
status: Primary event rules frozen before the primary scan. Matched-control design was frozen after primary output but before control output. Development diagnostic only; not a fill backtest.

data.holdout_policy: Do not query or evaluate 2026 data until a later combined level plus order-flow rule is frozen.

event.definition: Current 1m bar trades beyond a pre-existing level and closes back through it.
event.static_level_consumption: one event per unique static level identity

matched_control: For each level event, compare a deterministic non-event minute matched by symbol, calendar month, UTC hour and monthly ATR quintile. Report paired mean excess with bootstrap 95 percent interval.
reporting: Report count, gross forward return, MFE, MAE, cost-clearing rate and matched-control excess by symbol, level, side and horizon. No PnL or profitability claim.
